w10_T4_000459: A bus company printed 133 timetables for the new season, and the depot sent over 52 more. 53 of them were handed out to passengers at the station on the first morning. A school then asked for 30 timetables to be added to the office pile for a project. Every timetable still in the office lists 7 routes. The office has 9 filing cabinets along the back wall. The timetables show waiting gaps in minutes rather than in hours. How many route listings are there in the office's timetables altogether?
w10_T4_000460: A conference organiser ordered 208 tables, and 200 of them went straight into the main hall, leaving the rest for the small workshop room. Each workshop table seats 6 delegates, and every delegate is given 8 handouts. Each handout runs to 8 printed pages. The printer then pulled out 451 pages that had been duplicated by mistake. The venue is 12 kilometres from the airport. How many pages are there in the workshop handouts?
w10_T4_000461: On Monday morning a workshop counted 221 rolls of wire in the store, and every roll measures 8 metres. During the afternoon the team cut each metre into 7 short pieces. In the early evening every piece was bent into 2 hooks, and each hook was then dipped 6 times into the paint tank. The paint tank was installed 3 years ago. How many dips into the paint tank were made?
w10_T4_000466: Hakim's studio held 223 blank canvases at the start of the month, and 168 were bought in a clearance sale. His colleague Rana, who paints far fewer canvases than Hakim does, cut every canvas that was left into 6 small panels. Each panel was then scored into 7 little squares for a mosaic. The finished mosaic wall swallowed 1940 of those squares. How many squares are left over?
w10_T4_000467: A cider maker had 173 bottles racked in the cellar and a friend brought round 31 more. A second pressing then tripled the number of bottles in the cellar. All of them were packed equally into 4 crates ready for the market. A delivery van took 28 bottles out of the first crate on the way. How many bottles are in that first crate now?
w10_T4_000470: A festival ordered 226 wristbands and then asked the printer for 75 more. The printer doubled the whole order as a goodwill gesture, so the festival received 2 times what it had asked for. Half of the wristbands were sent straight over to the second gate. The main gate was then given 71 spare wristbands from last year's stock and 44 from a sponsor. Just before the gates opened the organiser had the main gate's supply doubled again, leaving it with 2 times as many as it had been holding. The festival runs for 3 days. How many wristbands does the main gate have?
w10_T4_000472: On Thursday morning a hotel had 128 clean pillowcases in the linen store, and housekeeping added 18 more straight from the dryer. Before lunch 74 were taken up to the guest rooms. During the afternoon a coach party's rooms used another 46. In the early evening the laundry returned 21 pillowcases, and later that night a delivery brought 39 new ones. How many pillowcases are in the linen store?
w10_T4_000474: A prepaid phone card started the month with 206 minutes on it. One long call home used up 178 minutes, and a run of short calls used another 25. The provider then ran an offer that replaced the balance with 5 minutes for every minute still on the card. A dropped call wasted 2 minutes, and a refund for that fault added 30 minutes back. The card is sold in minutes rather than in hours. How many minutes are on the card now?
w10_T4_000486: On Monday morning a labelling plant received 222 pallets, with 8 crates on every pallet and 5 boxes in every crate. During the afternoon the staff found 8 jars packed in each box, and every jar needs 7 labels. In the evening the machine ran out of stock and fell 338335 labels short of what the jars needed, and a small back-up printer produced 62 labels before the shift ended. The plant's log is written in minutes rather than in hours. How many labels were printed?
w10_T4_000502: A school shared 156 tennis balls equally among its 6 PE classes. Mr Adeyemi's class was then given a second set exactly the same size as its share, so it held 2 times as many balls as the other classes and more than Ms Bright's class ever kept. 20 of the balls went over the fence during the term and were never found. Every ball the class still had was used in 5 practice drills, and each drill was repeated 3 times. How many drill repetitions did the class run?
w10_T4_000504: On Saturday morning a farmer loaded 25 sacks of potatoes onto his trailer, and each sack holds 3 nets. Before noon he found that every net holds 2 bags. During the afternoon the market stall counted 9 potatoes in each bag. In the evening the chef worked out that every potato makes 4 portions of chips. How many portions of chips could be made from the trailer load?
w10_T4_000505: A carpenter had 22 planks stacked against the wall and used 10 of them building a bench. 1 plank split along the grain and was thrown out. A timber yard then delivered 56 more planks. Every plank in the workshop was cut into 7 slats, and each slat was drilled with 6 holes. The carpenter filled 1540 of those holes with dowels. A dozen chisels hang on the rack above his bench. How many holes are still empty?
w10_T4_000509: On Monday morning a warehouse had 200 sacks of flour and the mill delivered 72 more before nine o'clock. Later that morning the staff worked out that every sack fills 5 tubs. During the afternoon 1179 tubs were sent out to the bakeries. In the evening each tub still in the warehouse was split into 6 bags, and the bags were packed 2 to a box, one box for every pair. The warehouse records are kept in kilograms rather than in tonnes. How many boxes were packed?
w10_T4_000511: On Friday morning a garage had 130 tyres in the yard and fitted 89 of them to customers' cars. Before lunch a supplier delivered 80 more, and at two o'clock a dealership sent over 61. In the late afternoon all the tyres in the yard were split equally between the garage's 2 storage bays. In the evening the manager moved 77 tyres from a van into the first bay, and a night delivery added 15 more to that same bay. How many tyres are in the first bay?
w10_T4_000516: An olive oil producer filled 105 cases with 6 tins in every case. A neighbour added 72 loose tins to the same store. A festival order then took 400 tins away, and 18 came back unopened after the event. Every tin in the store earns a regular customer 9 loyalty points. The barn roof was mended 4 years ago. How many loyalty points do the tins in the store represent?
w10_T4_000518: On Tuesday morning a driving school had 197 minutes of lessons in the diary, and 89 minutes were cancelled by pupils before nine o'clock. The time that was left was shared equally among the school's 4 instructors. In the afternoon one of them took a new booking of 28 minutes, and in the evening a further 28 minutes was added to that same instructor's diary. The diary is kept in minutes rather than in hours. How many minutes does that instructor have booked?
w10_T4_000522: Ola packed 147 boxes of candles for the winter fair, and her friend Petra packed exactly as many, so the stall held 2 times Ola's own count of boxes. Every box contains 6 candles, and each candle is made with 2 wicks. A spare bag under the table held 38 loose wicks. How many wicks are on the stall?
w10_T4_000523: Jonas had 79 comics on his shelf and sold 40 of them at a collectors' fair. He lent another 14 to a schoolfriend who never brought them back. His sister Mira then gave him a bundle exactly the size of what he had left, so he held 2 times as many comics as before, though Mira kept fewer than Jonas did. He passed 15 on to a jumble sale and bought 52 at a second-hand shop. How many comics does Jonas have now?
w10_T4_000530: On Monday morning a laundry had 120 bags of washing waiting on the floor, and a hotel sent 65 more before lunch. During the afternoon the staff counted 8 items inside every bag. In the evening the machines got through half of all those items, and the rest waited until morning. Each item that was washed was then pressed with 5 strokes of the iron. The laundry van is 6 years old. The price list is written in cents rather than in dollars. How many strokes of the iron were needed?
w10_T4_000533: A sports day committee shared 150 medals equally among the 5 schools taking part. The head teacher at one school, Mr Vasquez, bought 55 more medals for his own pupils, and a parents' group donated 62 further medals to him, which was more than Mrs Okafor's school received all season. Every medal at Mr Vasquez's school is hung on a ribbon costing 8 cents, and a spare roll of ribbon cost him 60 cents. How many cents did the ribbon come to?
w10_T4_000539: A gym instructor taught 45 classes last month, and each class began with 7 minutes of warm-up. Across the month she also spent 40 minutes on stretching demonstrations. Cooling the classes down took a further 46 minutes in total, and she logged 39 minutes of paperwork. Her timesheet is kept in minutes rather than in hours. How many minutes did the instructor log for the month?
w10_T4_000544: Ben brought 14 folding tables to the community room, and his neighbour Sara brought exactly as many, so the room held 2 times Ben's own count. 5 of the tables had wobbly legs and were taken away to be mended, and 15 were carried outside for the barbecue. A hire company then delivered 37 more tables to the room. How many tables are in the community room?
w10_T4_000552: Dara had a dozen fishing floats in her tackle box and found 3 more in the shed. Her friend Ola gave her 64, far more than Dara had owned to begin with. Every float in the box was then fitted with 3 tiny beads to weight the line. A spare packet in the box already held 47 loose beads. How many beads does Dara have for her floats?
w10_T4_000558: On Monday morning a village post office had 236 parcels waiting, and 229 went out on the first van. Before lunch 2 more were collected by their owners at the counter. In the afternoon the postmaster worked out that every parcel still waiting needs 6 customs labels. In the evening he found 8 of those labels misprinted and binned them, then had a second identical set printed, leaving the office with 2 times as many labels as it had after the binning. The office logs collection times in minutes rather than in hours. How many customs labels does the office have?
w10_T4_000562: A council planted 234 street trees last spring and a developer paid for 67 more. Each tree is watered 7 times a month through the summer, and every watering uses 9 litres. A rainy spell saved the council 288 litres, and repairing a leaking hydrant saved a further 3915 litres. The water bill is worked out in litres rather than in cubic metres. How many litres does the council use?
